content_sections.heading: About KKHSOU
content_sections.text: Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University is a state university with its address at Resham Nagar, Khanapara, Guwahati-781022. This notice is for posts at its Headquarters (Rani Campus and City Campus) and at its Regional Centres in Bongaigaon, Jorhat, Lakhimpur and Silchar. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, with remuneration payable from the University Fund, on the terms and conditions prescribed by the University.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 53 vacancies for Assistant Professor (Contractual) across 18 disciplines. The columns STP and STH are copied as printed; the notice does not expand them. The notice also says any PWD (Persons with Disability) applicant found suitable will be considered for the vacancy in any discipline.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states the qualifications are as per the UGC Regulations, 2018, and subsequent amendments, wherever applicable. Candidates awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, as applicable, including subsequent amendments, are exempted from the NET/SLET/SET requirement, subject to the applicable UGC Regulations. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in the concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; and qualified NET conducted by the UGC or CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, such as SLET/SET.
rows.experience: Preference for relevant teaching or professional experience in Open and Distance Learning (ODL).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature. Remuneration is payable from the University Fund, subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the University. The initial period of engagement is six (6) months. It may be extended, subject to the University's requirements and satisfactory performance, up to a maximum period of one (1) year. No TA/DA is admissible to candidates for appearing in the interview.

rows.pay: ₹25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand only) per month on a consolidated basis

content_sections.heading: Application Fee and Selection
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances and must be paid online only, through the payment gateway link(s) provided in the application portal. The notice gives the same last date, 27 November 2026 up to 11:59 p.m., for the application form, fee payment and downloading the PDF copy of the submitted form. Selection has two stages stated in the notice. First, the Screening Committee(s) screen and shortlist candidates based on the information furnished in the online applications, and their decision is final and binding. Second, shortlisted candidates are invited to appear for an interview, as per the University's requirements. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria gives no right to be called for an interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KKHSOU Assistant Professor (Contractual)
content_sections.text: Submit the online application through the application portal. Applications by any other mode will not be entertained. Pay the application fee online only, through the payment gateway link(s) in the portal: ₹400/- for UR candidates, ₹200/- for reserved category candidates. Download the PDF copy of the submitted application form by 27 November 2026, up to 11:59 p.m. Bring the hard copy of the duly completed online application, with proof of payment and self-attested copies of the supporting documents, at the time of the interview. Bring all original certificates, testimonials and other documents for verification at the interview. The notice does not mention the interview date, time or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Hard copy of the duly completed online application Proof of payment of the application fee Self-attested copies of all relevant supporting documents substantiating the claims made in the online application Original certificates, testimonials and other relevant documents, for verification at the interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Submission of an application implies acceptance of the terms and conditions in the notice. Failure to produce the required original documents, or any discrepancy between the online application and the supporting documents, may lead to disqualification. The University reserves the right to withdraw any or all of the advertised posts at any stage without assigning any reason. The University also reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised vacancies, and its decision is final. Preference shall be given to candidates with relevant teaching or professional experience in Open and Distance Learning (ODL).

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts are there in KKHSOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 53 vacancies in 18 disciplines under Advt. No. CT 01/2026, with the largest number, 5 posts, in English.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KKHSOU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission, fee payment and downloading the PDF copy of the application is 27 November 2026, up to 11:59 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for KKHSOU Assistant Professor (Contractual)?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the concerned/relevant/allied subject, plus NET (UGC or CSIR) or SLET/SET. Ph.D. holders under the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET, subject to the applicable UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹400/- for Unreserved (UR) candidates and ₹200/- for Reserved Category candidates. It is non-refundable and payable online only.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the KKHSOU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online through the application portal; other modes are not entertained. At the interview, bring the hard copy of the application with proof of fee payment and self-attested copies of supporting documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Screening Committee(s) screen and shortlist candidates from their online applications, and shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a KKHSOU Assistant Professor (Contractual)?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹25,000/- per month on a consolidated basis, payable from the University Fund.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, for an initial six months, extendable up to a maximum of one year, subject to the University's requirements and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will candidates get TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is admissible to candidates for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can a PWD candidate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says any PWD applicant found suitable will be considered for the vacancy in any discipline.
